sn52.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Anuruddho āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-Moggalāno Sākete viharanti Kaṇṭakīvane || || Atha kho āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca MahāMoggalāno sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhitā yenāyasmā Anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Anuruddhena saddiṃ sammodiṃsu || sammodanīyaṃ katham sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantam Anuruddham etad avoca || || Sekhenāvuso Anuruddha bhikkhunā katame dhammā upasampajja vihātabbā ti || ||
sn52.4:2.1: Sekhenāvuso Sariputta bhikkhunā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbā || katame cattaro || || Idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampājāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || vedanāsu || citte || dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī || sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Sekhenāvuso Sāriputta ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbā ti || || 1--2.
